'''Nensu Kaatik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] who served as the [[Chair of the Senate/Legends|Chair of the Senate]]. In [[44 ABY]], he was present when [[Ivaar Workan]], posing as Kameron Suldar, nominated [[Padnel Ovin]] as a candidate for [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] following the fragmentation of the ruling Triumvirate. He was replaced by Suldar who took his place as Chair of the Senate.
